title: Trip Spend Rates for Upgrades into First — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Pricing table — upgrades into First on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The First upgrade price is multiplied by the **spend rate**, which follows the trip spend of the ticket. The rate acts on the unrounded price; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

## Trip spend

The trip spend of the ticket is its fare part plus every seat charge and every same-day change fee charged on the ticket, less every refund entry against a seat charge. Every seat charge on the ticket counts, on any segment; a refund entry counts when it is against a seat charge (standard, preferred or extra-legroom).

## The rate

| Trip spend (USD) | Spend rate |
|---|---|
| 400 or more (top spend floor) | 0.8 |
| At least 250 (high spend floor) and below 400 | 0.85 |
| At least 200 (middle spend floor) and below 250 | 0.92 |
| Below 200 | 1 |
